scientific_integrity: Deductive block decomposition and exact symbolic verification of the equality fiducial; numerical randomized tests are corroboration only. Source priority risk is disclosed. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: All spectra, optimality, and recovery claims are restricted to the natural three-dimensional complex representation of the order-twelve rotational tetrahedral group, rank-one projectors from a unit fiducial, unweighted orbit measurements, and Frobenius-normalized Hermitian matrix tomography. No claim that arbitrary 12-point designs or general phase-retrieval thresholds are new. A complete literature priority determination awaits specialist comparison.
title: Sharp tomography spectrum and a twelve-point projective \(2\)-design from tetrahedral rotations
